tasks.title: Repair the corrupted Customer model in this repo (project root). Problem: app/Models/Customer.php was destroyed by an earlier agent run - it now contains only `use HasFactory;` (unqualified, resolves to the nonexistent App\Models\HasFactory), `protected $table`, and a casts block, and it LOST the following from the original file: the imports `use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;` and `use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;`, the class trait line `use HasFactory, SoftDeletes;`, the HasMany import, and the three relationship methods hasmanyleavereplacement(), hasmanyoutstation(), hasmanysales() (each returning $this->hasMany(...) with the HRLeaveReplacement, HROutstation, and Sales models respectively). Fix: restore app/Models/Customer.php to its original content (you can get it from git: `git show HEAD:app/Models/Customer.php`) and then ADD a protected $casts = [ 'id' => 'integer', ]; block to it (place it right after protected $table, TAB-indented, trailing comma, per the app convention). The restored file must keep the HasFactory + SoftDeletes imports and all three relations intact, plus the new casts block. Verify: php -l app/Models/Customer.php must report No syntax errors, and the file must contain all of: `use HasFactory, SoftDeletes;`, `hasmanyleavereplacement`, `hasmanyoutstation`, `hasmanysales`, and `'id' => 'integer'`. Report the php -l result and a grep listing of the key lines.

Re-run the full verification after the Customer model repair in this repo (project root). Steps: (1) run php -l on app/Models/Customer.php - must be clean; (2) run the full PHP test suite `php artisan test` - must now reach the baseline: 47 passed / 159 assertions, zero fatal errors; (3) confirm the two excelreport fixes are still intact: app/Http/Controllers/API/AjaxSupportController.php line 25 has an ACTIVE (non-commented) `use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Bus;` import, and resources/js/modules/excelreport/form.js guards its minDate/maxDate calls behind non-empty checks; (4) run `npx mix` and confirm the bundle compiles. Report the exact test run result (suites, passed, failed, assertion count) with the test report contract, plus the confirmation of the two excelreport fixes.
